body.name: continuous terminal-envelope risks
body.construction: Replace each factor \(\mathbf 1\{a_j(x,q)<0\}\) in \(\ell_m(x,q)\) by \(f_\delta^-(a_j(x,q))\) or \(f_\delta^+(a_j(x,q))\), evaluate at the finite or diffusion terminal state, and take the corresponding Bayes infimum to obtain \(B_{n,\delta}^{\pm}(\lambda)\) and \(B_\delta^{\pm}(\lambda)\).
